snippet.title: Frontend Love
snippet.description:
On 19, 20 and 21st February 2020 we organised Frontend Developer Love which is the most dynamic frontend developer conference in the World combined with Vuejs Amsterdam makes it a 3-day javascript spectacle. In 2020 we have welcomed 3,649 visitors over 3-days in Theater Amsterdam who enjoyed the humongous 500m2 screen, 46 expert talks on various Frontend Developer topics on Angular, React, Vue and more..  

http://frontenddeveloperlove.com

Talks on #reactjs #angular #vuejs and more general #javascript

Twitter: https://twitter.com/frontend_love/
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/frontendlove/
Newsletter: https://frontenddeveloperlove.com/newsletter/
